args.subject: Child Seat Availability - New Car Rental London
args.body:
Hello,

I am writing to ask whether New Car Rental in London has child seats available for rental.

Could you please let me know:
- Whether child seats are available
- The types of child seats offered (e.g., infant, booster, toddler)
- Whether they need to be requested in advance and if there is any additional charge

Thank you for your help.

Best regards,
Emma Johnson

final_text:
I've sent the email to New Car Rental's support address.

**Details:**
- **Company:** New Car Rental (123 Oxford Street, London W1D 2HG, United Kingdom)
- **Support address found in review:** support@newcarrental.co.uk
- **Subject:** Child Seat Availability - New Car Rental London
- **Status:** Sent

The email asks whether child seats are available, what types they offer (infant, booster, toddler), and whether advance requests or additional fees apply. I also checked their available vehicle types (Sedan, SUV, Convertible), though child seat availability isn't listed there — hence the inquiry.
